task.title: Create an account with an API token

context.p: Keep the API address and your token in a .env file next to this page:

step.cmd: Load the variables from your .env file.
Send a POST request to $API_URL/accounts with the header Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN and this body:

info.p: The API returns status 200 and the new account, with plan set to team. Note the account's name and seats.

step.cmd: Look up the account. Send a GET request to $API_URL/accounts?name=<name>&seats=<seats>. The response shows the same name and seat count.
